clips.text: Man is not the end but only the means.
Man is not really a being but only a tension between two planes of being.
Man is only a bridge, that is why he cannot remain satisfied with himself.
His heart is nothing but a continent of discontent and his very being is anguish.
Religion is man's wish to pass beyond himself as he now is.
That is why I say man can never be irreligious; that is impossible.
He can pretend to be but he cannot be.
Religion is not something accidental or circumstantial, it is in the very nature of man: man is a religious animal And man is nothing if he is not a desire to transcend himself.
He can go below himself, or he can go above, but he cannot remain himself.
